_comment: Gold pairwise relation judgments between propositions (and a few proposition-vs-decoy-variant pairs). relation in {EQUAL, ENTAILS, ENTAILED_BY, CONTRADICTS, OVERLAPS, UNRELATED}. 'a REL b' reads left-to-right, e.g. K004 ENTAILS K004m means K004 => K004m.

pairs.rationale: Surface forms look like opposite claims (dR/dT>0 vs dR/dT<0), but subjects are disjoint types (Metal vs Semiconductor, per K019). Neither entails nor contradicts the other once material_class context is resolved. THE key test for the 'apparent contradiction from omitted context' failure mode.

K004 (general solid thermal expansion) entails K004m (metal case) because Metal is instance_of a solid-forming material class. Reverse does not hold: K004m does not entail the general solid law. Canonical GENERALIZES/SPECIALIZES test case.

K004m (metals expand) entails K004c (copper expands) since Copper instance_of Metal. This is the primary false-merge trap: a naive embedding-similarity canonicalizer will likely mark these EQUAL because the sentences are near-identical in structure ('Metals expand when heated' / 'Copper expands when heated').
Transitive closure of P02+P03: general solid expansion entails the copper instance. Used to check the entailment-graph transitivity constraint is actually enforced.

Most important case in v0. Surface forms directly negate each other ('water expands when heated' vs 'water contracts when heated'). Both are TRUE, in disjoint temperature_domain contexts (above 4C vs 0-4C). Correct system behavior: do not mark CONTRADICTS; recognize same subject (water, volume/length under heating) with context-dependent truth, i.e. OVERLAPS with a resolvable context split -- exactly the 'A^C1->B, A^C2->not B' pattern that should trigger a context-refinement step rather than a rejection.

K009 (boiling point at 1 atm = 100C) entails-under-added-context, but the decoy V009c ('water boils at 100C', no pressure clause) is a strictly weaker/ambiguous claim -- it holds at 1 atm but is false at altitude. Treat K009 ENTAILS V009c-as-stated-at-1atm, but V009c alone should not be filed as EQUAL to K009 since it silently drops a load-bearing condition. Scored as a false-merge trap.

K012 (distance/time under constant velocity) and V012c ('instantaneous speed = distance/time', no constancy qualifier) share subject matter but V012c is only true in the special case that reduces to K012's assumption; in general instantaneous speed is a derivative, not distance/time. Another context-dropped false-merge trap.

K001 (V=IR) together with K010 (P=IV) jointly entail K011 (P=I^2R) by substitution. As a HYPEREDGE: {K001, K010} -> K011. K001 alone does not entail K011 (needs K010 too) -- flagged so the benchmark scorer doesn't credit a system for merging K001 and K011 directly.

Same hyperedge as P08 -- K010 alone is a necessary but not sufficient premise for K011. Marked OVERLAPS (shares structure/derivation) rather than ENTAILS to avoid crediting single-premise entailment for what is actually a 2-premise hyperedge conclusion.

K018 is an ontological classification fact (Metal instance_of Conductor); K002 is a quantitative causal law about metals. Same subject type (Metal) but disjoint semantic content -- tests that the classifier doesn't over-merge same-subject propositions of different logical kinds (ontological vs causal).
Ideal gas law and Newton's second law share no concepts and no derivational relationship. Baseline negative control.
Density definition vs force law -- both simple algebraic identities, unrelated subjects. Negative control.

K019 (Metal and Semiconductor disjoint) is the ontological fact that JUSTIFIES resolving P01 as UNRELATED rather than CONTRADICTS -- it shares the Metal concept and is load-bearing background for P01, but does not itself entail or get entailed by K002.

Both are MONOTONIC_* propositions with a similar formal shape (radius/escape_velocity vs temperature/length) but completely different subject domains (astrophysics vs thermal expansion). Tests that the classifier doesn't over-merge on shared predicate SHAPE (MONOTONIC_POSITIVE/NEGATIVE) alone.

Heat-capacity relation vs a boiling-point instance fact -- adjacent topically (both about heat/water-ish) but no logical relationship. Near-miss negative control to test embedding-similarity false positives.
